note: Live-session recording of the SharePoint episode screens (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded. Set MG_TENANT, MG_UPN_DOMAIN and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID in the environment before queueing (never in a file). Sign-ins are device-code, done by the owner. Episodes 1-9 chain: set MG_KEEP_CHAIN=1 while recording them in order so teardown keeps what the next episode uses; unset it for a full clean-up. The home site is a tenant-wide setting: prepare records the current value so teardown can restore it. Provision and switch on global navigation the day before the browser screens (it can take up to 24 hours).
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
if (-not (Get-PnPTenantSite -Url "$env:MG_TENANT_URL/sites/Operations" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw 'Hub /sites/Operations not found: record episode 07 first (MG_KEEP_CHAIN=1)' }
# manual, in the browser: share /sites/Intranet with 'Everyone except external users' as visitors (IL005 checks it)

screens.name: provision
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
screens.note: Device-code sign-ins off camera. Record what really happens (Set-PnPHomeSite -Force, org assets CDN prompt, default nodes).

screens.name: app-bar
steps: Setup first, as labadmin on /sites/Intranet (brief or off camera): Settings > Global navigation: Enable on, Title 'Contoso', Logo contoso-globalnav-20.png from Brand Images, Navigation source 'Home site navigation', Save
As Alex Demo, open any SharePoint page such as Contoso Purchasing
Select the Contoso logo in the app bar on the left
Hold on the panel: Work (Operations > Contoso Operations, Purchasing, Facilities) and How do I (Everyday tasks > Buy something, Move office; Purchasing team > Supplier documents)
If the panel is empty, wait (up to 24 hours) and retry
mask: tenant host in the address bar (pipeline/mask.js)
account avatar and display name in the top bar
screens.note: Optional second capture as Sam Demo (no 'Purchasing team' label).

screens.name: picker
steps: Add an Image web part (+), select Change
In the file picker select 'Your organization' in the left pane
Hold on the card with the Contoso logo thumbnail, open it and show the two logos
mask: tenant host in the address bar (pipeline/mask.js)
account avatar and display name in the top bar
organization name on the card if it is the real tenant name

screens.name: check
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
commands: # somebody renames 'How do I' in the home site navigation
$n = Get-PnPNavigationNode -Location TopNavigationBar | Where-Object Title -eq 'How do I'; Set-PnPNavigationNode -Identity $n.Id -Title 'How to'
screens.note: The device-code prompt for the rename connection is shown off camera. Expect IL006 and '1 error(s)'.

teardown: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
# manual: switch global navigation off on the home site (Settings > Global navigation) before the site is deleted
needs: app:MG Lab PnP (+ Graph Group.Read.All delegated)
